samples.C: A and >1 unique score among original 15 Q1-Q13 items, unique id

amount_parameterizations.saturated: two amount indicators; joint interaction4df; scalar contrasts retain both adjacent changes as a 2df vector
amount_parameterizations.endpoint: 200/5000 respondents only, binary amount indicator; full endpoint change

models.logit: five binary thresholds; link-index contrasts, HC1 score sandwich; probability AMEs separately
models.probit: five binary thresholds; link-index contrasts, HC1 score sandwich; probability AMEs separately
models.ordered_location_scale: ordinal probit; same full location and scale form-by-amount design with baseline location0/scale1; HC1 score/Hessian sandwich

maxT.method: constrained-null centered score multiplier bootstrap; jointly shared person Gaussian multipliers; nuisance-adjusted full-design score influence at each no-interaction fit; fixed grid in every draw; no per-draw MLE refits
maxT.null: preserve form/amount nuisance main effects on each model's own scale; zero location interactions, scale model interactions also zero under its global null
maxT.vector_statistic: sqrt(robust Wald); scalar abs(z); all vector/component norms included in maximum
maxT.nonestimable: retain planned rows with reason; no silent drop; any failed model family makes global scope incomplete and prevents strong YES
maxT.simulation: 200 multinomial null draws on fixed cell-by-sample-membership groups, equal six-bin probabilities from pooled marginal; score-level family size check; 95% binomial CI; not full optimizer simulation

multiplicity.global: all1500 finite grid tests, no moderator additions
multiplicity.secondary: Holm within declared tables; no uncorrected winner selection

ordered_sensitivity: full/probit/logit/location-scale for all samples and amount representations in grid
bayesian: optional A5 not undertaken; does not replace maxT

equivalence.interpretation: revision-stage descriptive margin sensitivity; no independent SESOI or preregistration

bindingness.sparse: do not merge; report empty/unestimable bins
bindingness.continuous: form*ln(r) with amount indicators; association, not causal
bindingness.fixed: lower6>5000; equal-amount pooled Food-Cash level; form*z slopes

mappings.rank: rank-normalized income-band position separately within current/legacy scheme; logarithmic rank size is noncurrency sensitivity

relative_scale.material_improvement: relative mean CV loss reduction >=1%, CI improvement above0; smaller/mixed otherwise
relative_scale.earlier_compression: Cash z*standardized log-income interaction; positive means lower-income steeper decline; not direct categorization evidence

literature: all30 manuscript references audited, each2025-2026/current WP verified online primary source; direction verification before positive-control interpretation

decision_rules.YES: all finite-family coverage valid and focal omnibus/pairwise survive global.05; neither null simulation nor family failures invalidate
decision_rules.MIXED: only partial focal survival or approximation/incomplete coverage
decision_rules.NO: focal does not survive; no outcome/model switch
decision_rules.story_strength: A only complete strong evidence with bounded measurement/ethics disclosure; B suggestive when global correction fails or scope mixed; C if no consistent form-by-size evidence
decision_rules.mechanism: only direct process evidence establishes categorization; relative-scale predictive improvement is indirect supportive evidence at most
